_doc: Every building kind (PLAN §1.6, §3.2). Sizes in cells (0.5 m). `tag` decides what enemies may damage (§0.7: production | military | infra | town) — M4's js/sim/defence/targets.js reads it, nothing else may. `cost` is carried to the site by builders; `work` is builder-ticks of work once everything has arrived. `start: true` = on the ledger from the first day, otherwise `unlock` names the research.json row that adds it. `ring` = yard ring radius (cells from the centre): every building whose centre is inside it shares one store; overlapping rings join (one pool). `store` = how many units it holds. `sight` = sensor radius for the fog. `recipes` = what it can make (recipes.json), the first is the default. `reach` = how far from its centre a camp or drill works the ground. `crew` = carriers and builders it brings. `power.draw` / `power.supply` = per-base power (one number, ROAST 1.6). `jobs` = workers it needs (M7 fills them from the town; until then every job is filled). `look` = how it is drawn in cells: the footprint is paved with `floor`, then each feature is a rectangle [x, y, w, h] of a material, relative to the top-left corner. `door` = the side carriers and builders use. New kinds append rows; another milestone never edits these rows (M4 adds military rows, M6 the mana refinery and batteries, M7 the town rows).

list.name: Headquarters
list.about: Your bunker, its sensor mast and the main store. Everything you dig comes here.

list.name: Depot
list.about: A yard with a store. Everything inside its ring shares it. Put one beside far camps.

list.name: Hand camp
list.about: Four diggers with picks. Works the outcrop it stands beside (it picks the ore it can reach).

list.name: Lumber camp
list.about: Fells the trees around it for timber. Costs nothing (so you can never run out of wood for good). Put it at the edge of a wood.

list.name: Porters' hut
list.about: Four more porters for the dispatcher. They carry anywhere, slowly.

list.name: Sensor mast
list.about: Pushes the scope's sight out by a long way. Outcrops it sees go on the ORE chart.

list.name: Sawmill
list.about: Saws timber into planks.

list.name: Stonecutter
list.about: Cuts stone into building block.

list.name: Smelter
list.about: Melts ore into bars. Burns coal, or timber when there is no coal.

list.name: Generator
list.about: Burns coal (or timber) for power. Machines slow down evenly when the base is short.

list.name: Cart shed
list.about: Two mule carts. They carry four porters' worth, fast on roads and crawling off them.

list.name: Survey thumper
list.about: Thumps the ground every 30 s. The ring it sends out finds shallow deposits under the grass.

list.name: Drill
list.about: Three times a hand camp, but needs power. Stand it on a deposit the thumper found, or on an outcrop.

list.name: House
list.about: Beds for a family. Settlers walk in from the edge of the map when there is a free bed, food and water. Never attacked.

list.name: Farm field
list.about: A barn and a field of crops. Four farmhands. The crops burn — the farm replants what fire takes.

list.name: Fishery
list.about: Boats and drying racks. Put it on the bank of a river or lake.

list.name: Well
list.about: Drinking water for the houses. One keeper.

list.name: Commons
list.about: A square with a fire, stalls and lamps. Houses within 40 m of it are happier.

list.name: Lamp post
list.about: Lights the street at night. Houses in the dark are less happy.

list.name: Crystal harvester
list._m6: mana crystal cluster -> shards the porters haul like ore
list.about: Cutters with crystal saws. Stand it beside a mana crystal cluster; leave a few crystals and the cluster grows back.

list.name: Mana refinery
list._m6: must stand inside the HQ yard ring: its mana goes straight into the HQ mana store
list.about: Boils crystal shards down to mana and pours it into the HQ's store. Must stand inside the HQ's yard ring. Brings the Mana Gauge and the Spell Board.

list.name: Mana battery
list._m6: one kind, global Battery level; raises the mana cap (mana.json battery) and opens spell tiers; bursts when destroyed
list.about: A stack of crystal cells that holds more mana. Raises the cap, which opens the stronger spells. Bursts if it is destroyed while charged.

list.name: Watch post
list.about: A lookout with a lamp and a crossbow. Sees a long way and lights the ground round it at night.

list.name: Bolt thrower
list.about: A heavy crossbow on a turntable. One big hit at a time, a long way out. Needs something to see by.

list.name: Gun nest
list.about: Sandbags and a rattling gun. Shreds a swarm up close. Loud — it draws them in.

list.name: Mortar pit
list.about: Lobs shells over your own walls. Breaks the ground and sets it alight where they land. Needs watch posts to see for it.

vectors._doc: Drawn lines (§3.2). ONE road kind (owner): a road over shallow water is a bridge. `width` is the stamp radius in cells and must match js/world/vectors.js. Global levels (§3.2 `levels`) decide what a road may cross: `reach[bridge level]` lists the water/lava kinds a bridge spans; `stairsAt` is the Road level that lets a road climb a cliff. `joinCells` = an end that comes within this distance of another road (or a building) joins it. Roads cost nothing to lay; bridges cost `bridgeCost` per cell of span. `layTicks` = builder-ticks per cell of road. M4 adds a `wall` row here; M10 a `rail` row.

wall._doc: M4. ONE wall kind (owner): a wall is drawn as a smooth line and SIMULATED as cells (`width` = the stamp radius, must match js/world/vectors.js widths.wall). Easy to draw (PLAN §0.8): an end within `joinCells` (3 m) of another wall joins it, an end within `snapCells` of a cliff or deep water/lava runs on to it, the blueprint goes down at once. A drag is simplified with tolerance `simplify` cells (a roughly straight drag becomes straight, corners stay) and smoothed like a road; Shift = ruler straight. `sectionCells` = one section (4 m) with its own hit points (upgrades.json wall levels). `cost` per cell of wall; `layTicks` builder-ticks per cell. Broken sections are rebuilt and worn ones patched (below `patchBelow` of full) once no enemy has been within `quietCells` for `quietTicks`. A road crossing a wall gets a gate in that section by itself (the gate offer is taken; CLEAR the gate to seal it).
